inventory.description: Pure, host-testable products of Packages/VisualCore: VisualCoreMath, VisualCoreSimulation, VisualCoreScenes, VisualCoreShaderSource, VisualCoreEffectsGraph, VisualCoreDiagnostics, VisualCoreAudioDSP, VisualCorePersistence, VisualCoreParameters, VisualCoreExperience (plus VisualCoreTestSupport for tests). iOS products of Packages/VisualCoreRendering: VisualCoreRendering, VisualCoreEffects, VisualCoreUI, VisualCoreAudio, VisualCoreAutomation, VisualCoreExperienceHost. For Effects Composer (checked 2026-11-19): VisualCoreRendering has RenderHost (renderOffscreen, readPixels, recreateContext), RenderContext, FieldPass with FieldUniform and FieldPassError, RenderTarget (readPixels, upload(rgbaFloats:)), Texture.upload(rgba:), TextureFormat (rgba8, rgba16f, r8), PingPongTarget, FloatRenderSupport, ResourceRegistry (program, makeRenderTarget, acquireTarget, recycle, trimPools, stats, budget, maxTextureSize), RenderCapabilities, ShaderBundle with the vc/ library, StillImage, StillImageEncoder and StillCapture; VisualCoreEffectsGraph has EffectGraphDescription, EffectGraphValidator and PassSchemas; VisualCoreEffects has EffectRenderer and EffectScene; VisualCoreShaderSource has ShaderLibrary, InfoLogParser and ShaderDiagnostic; VisualCoreParameters has ParameterDefinition, ParameterSchema, ParameterEditor and Preset; VisualCorePersistence has MigrationChain, DocumentStore, DocumentEnvelope, StoreProblem, NamedLibrary and TemporaryFolder; VisualCoreScenes has ExportGeometry; VisualCoreExperience has ExperienceStorage, ExperienceControl and ExperienceCore. Missing in every framework product (grep 2026-11-19): a byte-wise upload into a RenderTarget, any image decoding into pixels (no CGImage or UIImage path), a photo picker, an sRGB texture format, vec3 and mat4 field uniforms, a shared still-export Transferable and structured per-pass diagnostics from EffectRenderer.

inventory.area: EGL render host and its main-thread rule
inventory.description: RenderHost (@MainActor) owns the EGL display, context and surfaces over ANGLE's Metal backend (EGLDisplayProvider), the CAMetalLayer RenderView, the FrameScheduler and the context generations, and exposes capabilities, resources (ResourceRegistry), renderOffscreen, readPixels, pause, resume and recreateContext. RenderHost, ResourceRegistry, RenderScene and ExperiencePresenter are main-actor: GL work happens only inside a scene's setup, resize, render and teardown with the host's context current, on the main thread. A presenter receives a RenderContext (generation, pixel size, framebuffer, resources), never the host. The GL calls exist only in the internal CVisualCoreGL shim, which is no product.

inventory.area: Programs, full-screen passes with sampler inputs, render targets and their budget
inventory.description: ResourceRegistry.program(vertex:fragment:defines:library:...) compiles and links in the host's context with ShaderError diagnostics and an LRU program cache (maxCachedPrograms 64). FieldPass runs a fragment over every pixel of a RenderTarget or the framebuffer with named sampler2D RenderTarget inputs and typed FieldUniform values (float, vec2, vec4, int), validated before any draw; it refuses to sample its own output (FieldPassError.inputIsOutput) and reports compile failures as FieldPassError.compile. ResourceRegistry.makeRenderTarget checks framebuffer completeness; acquireTarget, recycle and trimPools pool targets; PingPongTarget pairs two; TextureFormat is rgba8, rgba16f or r8; FloatRenderSupport reports whether rgba16f is renderable; ResourceBudget (256 MiB by default, per-kind limits) refuses allocations over budget and ResourceRegistry.stats reports live bytes, peaks and shader failures.

RenderTarget.readPixels and RenderHost.readPixels read RGBA8 bytes back; RenderHost.renderOffscreen renders a still into a StillImage. Texture.upload(rgba:) uploads RGBA8 bytes into a Texture, which FieldPass cannot sample (its inputs are RenderTargets); RenderTarget.upload(rgbaFloats:) takes four floats per pixel. No byte-wise RenderTarget upload exists (U-RGBAUPLOAD).

inventory.area: The vc/ GLSL library and shader sources
inventory.description: ShaderLibrary (VisualCoreShaderSource) expands #include with line origins and caps (maxExpandedBytes, maxIncludeDepth); ShaderBundle compiles bundled GLSL ES 3.00 with the vc/ library (ShaderBundle.visualCoreLibrary): noise.glsl, palette.glsl, color.glsl (vc_srgbEncode, vc_srgbDecode), hash.glsl, sdf.glsl and field.glsl. InfoLogParser turns a GL info log into ShaderDiagnostic lines mapped to source origins.

EffectGraphDescription (Codable), EffectGraphValidator (quota, cycles, at most 32 passes) and PassSchemas describe a graph; the GPU EffectRenderer and EffectScene render it with pooled targets over a closed set of pass types (copy, colorMatrix, blur, bloom, distort, composite, feedback, flashLimit) whose runners and shaders are internal, so new effects cannot be added from outside, and its diagnostics are registry warnings (lastWarnings, failedPasses). Effects Composer does not use it (clarification Q1, research D6).

FrameInfo (index, time, delta clamped by FramePacing, targetTimestamp) is passed to every render call; ExperiencePresenter.maxFramesPerSecond caps the presenter's rate. Effects Composer redraws its preview when the chain, a parameter or the source changes.

inventory.area: Diagnostics, resource statistics and renderer capabilities
inventory.description: ResourceRegistry.stats (ResourceLedger.Snapshot with liveBytes, peakBytes, staleRejected, shaderFailures and warnings), ResourceBudget, RenderLifecycle, RenderHostError.contextLost, ProcessMemory.footprint(); RenderCapabilities (GL and GLSL version, renderer, extensions, maxTextureSize) on RenderHost.capabilities, ResourceRegistry.maxTextureSize and ResourceRegistry.renderCapabilities; InfoLogParser and ShaderDiagnostic for compile and link logs.

ParameterDefinition (range, default, clamped, normalized), ParameterSchema, ParameterEditor, Preset and ExperienceControl describe bounded controls; ParameterPanel (VisualCoreUI) shows them. ExperienceStorage (StorageQuota 16 MiB, 64 files) holds an experience's files; MigrationChain, DocumentStore, DocumentEnvelope and StoreProblem (corrupt, wrongKind, newerVersion, tooLarge) give versioned envelopes that refuse damaged and newer files; NamedLibrary keeps named items. StillImageEncoder writes PNG, JPEG and HEIC through ImageIO tagged sRGB (isAvailable per format); ExportGeometry bounds export sizes (hardMaxEdge 8,192, defaultMaxPixels 64,000,000); TemporaryFolder holds export files.

ExperienceSession opens, checkpoints, closes and recovers an Experience on one RenderHost and applies quality, memory-warning and scene-phase events and recreateContext; ExperienceShell adapts an ExperiencePresenter (scene, controls, pointer input, canvas overlay, maxFramesPerSecond); ExperienceCore is the GPU-free state with its qualityTiers; ExperienceStorage and ExperienceSnapshot persist it. The one app registers experiences in ExperienceRegistry and Catalog/registrations.json: twenty-four registered (A01-A24), candidates empty (checked 2026-11-19); a25 is no registration, AppModelTests uses it as the synthetic not-yet-integrated id, and Effects Composer stays unregistered and unavailable in A25-P00. The catalog lists it as free, family Developer and creator tools, launcher category tools. The app already carries NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription (project.yml) for experiences that declare photo-library-add.

XcodeGen spec project.yml for the one app (target VisualCore), package schemes via scripts/xcodebuild_package.py, app tests via scripts/xcodebuild_app.py, and scripts/release_check.py: python3 scripts/release_check.py --list prints 178 lines (2026-11-19): shared checks including app-contracts (every docs/apps/*/visualcore-contract.json), licenses, copy claims and usage-descriptions; package and app builds and tests; experience-release and copy-claims steps of the released experiences; verify steps of the registered experiences on iOS 27 and 26; the release audits; the seven reference regression steps and the ProjectM independence check. No A25 step exists yet; they come with G-RELEASE.

Effects Composer owns its domain and UI under Packages/ExperiencesCreative/EffectsComposer/ (Core GPU-free, CoreTests, Experience with Adapter/, ExperienceTests; created in A25-P01, not present today): the effect definition, node, chain, parameter and output-settings models and their caps; the five effect programs; the chain compiler and its pass plan; the target pool policy; the diagnostics mapping; editing, preview and compare; the image import (system picker, ImageIO decoding, scaling cap); colour boundaries; presets; still export and its Transferable; copy. VisualCore owns reusable machinery: the host, passes, targets, programs and read-back (VisualCoreRendering, VisualCoreExperienceHost), shader sources and diagnostics (VisualCoreShaderSource), parameters (VisualCoreParameters), persistence (VisualCorePersistence), export geometry (VisualCoreScenes) and storage (VisualCoreExperience); U-RGBAUPLOAD is VisualCoreRendering's. ProjectM stays in the harness.

Reference pinned at d93edd1, read-only; scripts/run_reference_baseline.py lists the ordered reference steps; scripts/check_reference_clean.py checks the submodule; the 7 release-check steps run in two chunks via release_check.py --only (reference-engine-xcframework, reference-build-projectm-ios-sim, reference-clean; reference-test-anglerendering-ios27, reference-test-anglerendering-ios26, projectm-reference-ios27, projectm-reference-ios26), recorded in docs/apps/effects-composer/regression-baseline.md (T-A25-001, T-A25-005). Phase start for the no-change diff of Packages and External: a2d68e21 (after the A25 constitution commit eec911ea).

gaps.justification: The effect definition, node, chain, parameter and output-settings models (manual §6) are the experience's domain, pure and GPU-free in its Core, versioned with MigrationChain and with documented caps on chain length, parameter ranges and source and export edges (research D5). No second user exists for them (Principle II).
gaps.test: Core host tests: each model round-trips and migrates; truncated, newer, NaN, infinite and out-of-range values and values one past each cap (chain length, parameter range, edges) are refused with a named reason.

gaps.justification: The five built-in effects are the experience's content: FieldPass fragment programs generated in code with bounded parameters, wider values packed into vec4 uniforms (clarification Q1). EffectRenderer's closed pass set cannot take them (research D6).
gaps.test: Core tests: each effect's parameter set has finite bounds and defaults inside them; experience tests compile each program in the host's context and check a known pixel of each effect on the built-in test image against a CPU reference within a tolerance.

gaps.justification: Compiling the linear chain into an ordered pass plan with intermediate-target lifetimes, skipping disabled effects and never letting a pass sample the target it writes, after Visual Programming Lab's PreviewPipeline (clarification Q1). The rules are specific to the chain.
gaps.test: Core tests: plans for empty, single, all-disabled and full chains; no pass reads its output; each intermediate's lifetime ends after its last reader; the peak number of live targets is at most two. Experience test: a compiled chain draws and matches the effects applied one by one.

gaps.justification: The chain's target pool reuses ResourceRegistry.acquireTarget and recycle under the ResourceBudget, with app-local caps on target count and bytes per preview and export size (manual §13 risk 3).
gaps.test: Experience tests: repeated edits and recompiles leave ResourceRegistry.stats live target count and bytes constant; a request over the cap is refused with a named reason; trimPools after close returns the pool to zero.

gaps.justification: Compile and link failures arrive as FieldPassError.compile text and are mapped to ShaderDiagnostic lines per effect, after Shader Studio's DiagnosticMapper (clarification Q4); EffectRenderer's diagnostics are only registry warnings.
gaps.test: Experience test: a deliberately broken program fixture yields a diagnostic naming the effect and line, the chain keeps the last good preview, and ResourceRegistry.stats counts the shader failure.

gaps.justification: Reorder, enable and disable with an immediate recompiled preview, with accessible non-drag alternatives, are the experience's editing interface.
gaps.test: Core tests: reorder, enable and disable produce the expected chain and are undoable; experience tests: an edit recompiles and redraws within one frame, and VoiceOver move actions reorder without drag.

gaps.justification: The before and after compare keeps the decoded source target untouched and shows it beside or instead of the result; the compare mode is the experience's interface.
gaps.test: Experience test: with compare on, the shown pixels equal the source's; the source target is never a pass output in any plan (Core plan check).

gaps.justification: The system photo picker (SwiftUI system API, out of process, no permission or usage string), ImageIO decoding into RGBA bytes on the CPU scaled so the longer edge is at most the smaller of RenderCapabilities.maxTextureSize and the experience's cap, kept for re-upload after context loss, and the cancelled-pick fallback to the built-in test image (clarification Q2). No other experience imports images.
gaps.test: Experience tests with generated image fixtures: an image above the limit is scaled to the stated edge, a damaged file is refused with a named reason, a cancelled pick keeps the built-in test image, and the kept bytes re-upload after recreateContext.

gaps.justification: An additive, public byte-wise RenderTarget.upload(rgba:) in VisualCoreRendering, because Texture.upload(rgba:) fills a Texture that FieldPass cannot sample and upload(rgbaFloats:) needs four floats per pixel, quadrupling the CPU memory of a large image (clarification Q2). Generic: any experience that feeds bytes into a pass input can use it.
gaps.test: VisualCoreRendering tests: bytes uploaded into an rgba8 and an rgba16f target read back equal (or within half-float tolerance); a wrong-length array and a stale target are refused; with /// docs, the API baseline update and the seven-step reference regression in two chunks.

gaps.justification: Presets are versioned envelopes in ExperienceStorage over MigrationChain and DocumentStore; damaged, newer and non-finite files are refused and never deleted automatically (clarification Q4). The preset format is the experience's.
gaps.test: Core and experience tests: a preset round-trips; truncated, newer, wrong-kind, oversize and NaN files are refused with a named reason and left on disk; a saved preset reloads the same chain.

gaps.justification: Export renders the chain at the export size into a pooled target, reads it back, encodes it with StillImageEncoder after a size and format check against ExportGeometry and StillImageEncoder.isAvailable, and hands the file to a Transferable and ShareLink the person opens, after Living Wallpapers (clarification Q4). No shared still-export Transferable exists.
gaps.test: Experience tests: an export at a valid size produces a decodable PNG, JPEG or HEIC of that size tagged sRGB; sizes over the edge or pixel cap and unavailable formats are refused before rendering; the temporary file is removed after the share.

gaps.justification: Colour-space boundaries: sRGB-encoded source and export bytes; each pass states whether it decodes to linear light (vc_srgbDecode) and encodes back (vc_srgbEncode); intermediates are rgba16f where FloatRenderSupport reports it renderable and rgba8 otherwise (clarification Q3). The per-effect rules are the experience's.
gaps.test: Experience tests: an identity chain round-trips a generated sRGB ramp within one code value on both the rgba16f and the forced rgba8 path; a known effect on a mid-grey matches a CPU linear-light reference.

gaps.justification: Memory limits, oversized sources, resize, orientation and context loss during editing and export (rebuilding the plan, pool and source target from CPU state), memory warnings, and the device plan are the experience's robustness work over VisualCore's recreateContext and budget (manual §13 risks 2 and 3).
gaps.test: Experience tests: after recreateContext the preview matches the one before; a resize mid-edit redraws at the new size; an export interrupted by a context loss reports a named failure and leaves no file; a memory warning trims the pool. Device plan written for D1-D3.

gaps.justification: Registration (with photo-library-add), the A25 release-check, copy-claims and verify steps, privacy and credits, licenses and catalog availability are the experience's release work in the one app.
gaps.test: experience-release-a25 and copy-claims-a25 pass in release_check.py; the verify steps pass on iOS 27 and 26; every store claim names a test; no professional colour-accuracy or editor-compatibility claim appears.

Risk 1, colour-space mistakes create wrong output. Owner: the colour boundaries of each pass and the intermediate format choice (app-local G-COLOR, A25-P05) over vc_srgbDecode, vc_srgbEncode, FloatRenderSupport and StillImageEncoder's sRGB tagging. Verification: experience tests round-trip a generated sRGB ramp through an identity chain within one code value on the rgba16f and the forced rgba8 path, and compare a known effect against a CPU linear-light reference; exports are checked to be tagged sRGB. Release blocker: an identity chain that shifts colours beyond one code value, an export without an sRGB tag, or any pass whose colour boundary is undeclared.

Risk 2, large images exceed texture limits. Owner: the import (app-local G-IMPORT, A25-P03) scaling the decoded image so its longer edge is at most the smaller of RenderCapabilities.maxTextureSize and the experience's cap, the byte-wise upload (U-RGBAUPLOAD, VisualCore:VisualCoreRendering, A25-P03) and oversized-source handling on devices (G-ROBUST, A25-P05). Verification: experience tests import generated images above the limit and check the stated edge, refuse damaged files, and check that an export over ExportGeometry's edge or pixel cap is refused before rendering; the device campaign imports the largest supported photo. Release blocker: any texture or target allocated above maxTextureSize, a crash or memory termination on a large image, or an image silently cropped.

Risk 3, intermediate targets grow without bound. Owner: the pass plan's lifetimes (G-COMPILER, A25-P02) and the bounded pool over ResourceRegistry.acquireTarget, recycle and trimPools under ResourceBudget (G-POOL, A25-P02), with memory warnings in G-ROBUST (A25-P05). Verification: Core tests prove the peak number of live targets for any chain; experience tests prove repeated edits, recompiles and exports leave ResourceRegistry.stats live bytes constant and a request over the cap is refused. Release blocker: live target bytes that grow with edits or exports, or any allocation outside the pool's caps.

reasons: A working host exists: RenderHost on OpenGL ES -> ANGLE -> Metal (main-actor) draws any RenderScene inside setup, resize, render and teardown, with renderOffscreen, readPixels and recreateContext, all public and tested (RenderHostTests, SessionOpenCloseTests, ShellRenderingTests).

FieldPass samples render targets into offscreen render targets in the host's context and refuses to sample its own output; Visual Programming Lab's PreviewPipeline and Fluid Art Playground already chain FieldPasses this way (FieldPassTests, PingPongTargetTests, OffscreenExportTests). The stop condition of US4 scenario 2 is therefore not met.

Targets, pools, the budget, read-back, the encoder and storage exist as public, tested building blocks: ResourceRegistry.makeRenderTarget, acquireTarget, recycle, trimPools, ResourceBudget and stats; RenderTarget.readPixels; StillImageEncoder and ExportGeometry; ExperienceStorage, MigrationChain and DocumentStore; ShaderLibrary, the vc/ library with vc_srgbEncode and vc_srgbDecode, and InfoLogParser (ResourceRegistryTests, ResourceLedgerTests, StillFormatTests, ExportGeometryTests, DocumentStoreTests, InfoLogParserTests).

14 of 37 rows are available with tests; all 23 non-available rows have owned gaps: G-MODEL and G-EFFECTS in A25-P01; G-COMPILER, G-POOL and G-DIAG in A25-P02; G-EDIT, G-COMPARE, G-IMPORT and U-RGBAUPLOAD in A25-P03; G-PRESETS and G-EXPORT in A25-P04; G-COLOR and G-ROBUST in A25-P05; G-RELEASE in A25-P06.

The one upstream gap is additive and has a planned phase: U-RGBAUPLOAD adds a byte-wise RenderTarget.upload(rgba:) to VisualCoreRendering in A25-P03 with tests, docs, the API baseline and the reference regression; until then nothing blocks the model, effects and compiler phases, which use generated test images.

The only permission is photo-library-add (Save Image from the share sheet), already described by the app; the system picker needs none. Effects Composer stays unregistered (24 registered, A01-A24, candidates empty) until A25-P01 creates Packages/ExperiencesCreative/EffectsComposer with its targets and first real rules.
